issue.title: EQL: Enable all correctness tests

labels.name: Team:QL (Deprecated)
labels.description: Meta label for query languages team

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
The correctness test is yet another sanity check for making sure EQL behaves correctly. However right now a handful of tests are disabled either because of missing functionality or because the results do not match.
This is a meta ticket for tracking progress so that all tests are passing regardless of the result positioning.

- [x] query 10 is disabled #63742
- [x] queries 29, 30, 31, 34 disabled (fixed by #65156 [here](https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/65156/files#diff-84b30523d9ca2a02a15d03b7b0dd9fee48e4cd6039e2d2e998e52568fc2cf6b1R511))
- [x] query 28 disabled #65188
- [x] query 32, 33 disabled #66018
